property: In MultiPartParser.parse(), the uploaded file name passed to the upload handler is produced solely by MultiPartParser.sanitize_file_name(), which must perform html.unescape() first, then strip Windows-style backslash paths, and apply os.path.basename() last, so no path-separator characters (real or entity-encoded) can remain in the returned name.
vulnerability: MultiPartParser.parse() ran os.path.basename() on the raw Content-Disposition filename before HTML-unescaping it, so an attacker could HTML-entity-encode path separators (e.g. '../') to survive the basename() check and only become real '../' sequences after unescaping, letting a custom upload handler write files outside the intended upload directory.
